I will add parameter_spread as a maximize objective with a weight that meaningfully encourages exploration relative to the current distance_from_center weight (0.25).
decision.expected_benefit_hypothesis: Increasing explicit reward for per-candidate parameter spread should increase exploration (higher parameter_spread and likely higher distance_from_center variance), helping the optimizer escape the low-performance basin so that in subsequent iterations higher-performing regions can be found.
decision.validation_plan_suggested_by_judge: Watch the next few iterations for an increase in mean and std of parameter_spread and distance_from_center (contrasting to current stds: 0.0008 for distance and 0.0005 for performance). decision.rationale: Performance is extremely low (mean=0.0189, best=0.0209) while exploration objectives have explicit weights (0.6 and 0.4) and show moderate values (~0.21). Increasing the numerical weight on the performance objective will increase exploitation pressure toward higher-performing designs without changing scorers or workflow mechanics.
decision.expected_benefit_hypothesis: Stronger selection pressure on device performance should drive the optimizer toward regions with higher measured performance (increase in mean and best performance and increased variance), reducing wasted iterations exploring low-performance regions. It may temporarily reduce within-population diversity, which can be monitored and corrected later if needed.
decision.validation_plan_suggested_by_judge: Run the next iteration(s) with the new weight and check whether candidate-wise performance statistics improve versus iteration 2 (increase in mean performance and/or best performance). If no meaningful improvement after a few iterations, consider switching to a short high-exploration experiment or dropping one exploration objective.
